title: Pan-Seared Squid Tacos with Jeweled Salsa
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional seafood tacos, featuring pan-seared squid and a vibrant jeweled salsa.
instructions: Rinse the squid tubes under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
Cut the squid tubes into bite-sized pieces.
Season the squid with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1-2 tablespoons of oil to the skillet and sear the squid for 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the squid from the skillet and set aside.
Warm the tacos according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of squid onto a warmed taco, followed by a spoonful of jeweled salsa, some baby corn, and a sprinkle of Oaxacan cheese.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro and a lime wedge.
